change: Removed 'abs' (Upper Rectus Abdominis, LowerRectus Abdominis) from secondary. The core activation during a floor glute bridge is primarily transverse abdominis (not mappable) rather than rectus abdominis; including it was an inflation. Retained Hamstrings and Gluteus Medius as secondary.

No changes. Primary biceps (Biceps Brachii) and secondary forearms (Wrist Flexors) are correct. Holding the horns demands wrist flexor stabilization. Brachialis is engaged but has no allowed mapping, so omitted correctly.

Changed primary mid back latins from ['Rhomboids', 'Upper Traps'] to ['Rhomboids', 'Lower Traps']. The gorilla row is a bent-over rowing motion with scapular retraction, which activates the lower/middle trapezius (Lower Traps) rather than the upper traps. Upper traps are involved in shrugging/shoulder elevation, not the retraction pattern of a row. All other secondaries (biceps, forearms, obliques, Lower Back, Posterior Deltoid) confirmed correct by multiple sources.

Removed 'abs' (Upper Rectus Abdominis, LowerRectus Abdominis) from secondary — core stabilization in hip thrusts is primarily transverse abdominis (unmappable), not rectus abdominis. Added 'Lower Back' (Erector Spinae) as secondary — EMG research (Bret Contreras, systematic reviews) confirms erector spinae activates as a stabilizer during hip thrusts.

Same corrections as kettlebell_hip_thrusts: removed 'abs' (rectus abdominis inflation), added 'Lower Back' (Erector Spinae) as secondary. The bench variant has greater range of motion and confirmed erector spinae stabilizer role per EMG studies.
